set.body:
Outcome
Translate appearance into public ScalaDock hooks with correct CSS precedence and lifecycle.

Owned scope
meridian-scaladock source/resources/tests

Prerequisites
A3, B0

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Map every documented -dock-* token (including legacy aliases) on .dock from generated semantic values; distinguish focus, selection and essential boundaries.
- [ ] Install adapter recipes after dock.css and assert computed paints in main root, float, ghost and menus; no dependency on private ScalaDock node anatomy.
- [ ] Propagate appearance/density/text-scale/motion to existing/new/restored windows atomically on the FX thread, using the generic provider APIs.
- [ ] Dispose subscriptions and registrations deterministically; repeated binds/unbinds and 100 appearance changes leave one stylesheet entry per intended resource and no retained closed windows.
- [ ] Keep scientific content palette and persisted pane/domain state independent of appearance.

Required evidence
Computed-style tests, subscription/stylesheet counts, new/restored/popout lifecycle probes and token coverage report.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code B1. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [B1] Implement the Meridian-to-ScalaDock adapter
